title: Why Minus Times Minus Is Plus ➕
topic: Why is a negative times a negative a positive?
claims: Negative times negative is positive because reversing direction twice points you forward.
Negative three times positive four equals negative twelve.

title: Why Transformers Need Changing Current ⚡
topic: Why does a transformer only work with alternating current (AC)?
claims: Transformers require a changing magnetic flux to induce voltage in the secondary coil via Faraday's law of induction.
Direct current produces a static magnetic field after initial turn-on, creating zero steady-state induced voltage in the secondary coil.
Alternating current continuously changes direction, producing the necessary changing magnetic field.
Answer to Try this: A moving magnet changes the magnetic flux through the coil, which induces an electromotive force (voltage).
